 Anthony Thompson USA TODAY Nov. 5, 2026, 12:42 p.m. ET Hear this story Baby Brezza Enterprises is recalling about 29,000 SuperFast Sterilizer Dryers after reports that the appliances can overheat, thus creating a potential burn hazard for consumers.
 The recall, announced Nov. 5 , involves countertop appliances designed to sterilize and dry baby bottles, breast pump parts and accessories in 10 minutes, according to the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission.
 The CPSC says Baby Brezza has received 32 reports of the products overheating or their plastic housing melting. No injuries have been reported.
 Here's what to know about the recall.
 More recalls: Blood pressure medication recalled nationwide. See the affected drug USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors. Which Baby Brezza sterilizer dryers are recalled?
 The recall covers SuperFast Sterilizer Dryers with model numbers BRZ0083, BRZ0154 and BRZ0156. Consumers can find the model number on the product label on the bottom of the appliance.
 The recalled products were sold at TJ Maxx and Marshalls stores nationwide, and online at Baby Brezza, Target and Babylist from January 2024 through October 2026. They sold for between $160 and $180.
 What should consumers do if they own a recalled Baby Brezza dryer?
 Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled appliances and contact Baby Brezza to receive a free replacement. Shipping is also free.
 To obtain a replacement, consumers must register on the company's recall website and complete a recall form. They will be instructed to unplug the appliance, cut the power cord to destroy it and upload photos of the destroyed product, the model number label and the return authorization number.
 After submitting the photos, consumers should dispose of the appliance according to local and state ordinances.

 Consumers can call Baby Brezza Enterprises at 888-527-9824 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday or email recall@babybrezza.com.
 More information and the recall registration form are available at Baby Brezza's recall website . Consumers can also visit www.babybrezza.com and select "Product Safety Recall" at the bottom of the page.
